changelog: Episode thumbnail blur is installed before asynchronous Coil image delivery, so current CloudStream result rows are blurred reliably
Already tracked and recycled episode rows are rechecked immediately instead of being skipped by stale listener state
GPU reveal no longer restores an old thumbnail after RecyclerView reuse, and legacy hardware bitmaps are copied safely before blur
Animated blur rendering is covered by an Android API 35 pixel-level instrumentation test
message: CS3M v668 — Thumbnail-Blur am Coil-Ladepfad repariert
